approved_by: abhillash (PM Agent OS — synthetic demo approval)
problem: SYNTHETIC DEMO: operators need a heartbeat endpoint and safe operator-config parsing; this contract exists to demonstrate the engineering pipeline, not to ship a product.
target_user: Operators monitoring small self-hosted services (synthetic persona).
desired_outcome: An operator can verify liveness with one call and load configuration without code execution risk.

functional_requirements.title: Safe config parsing
functional_requirements.description: parse_config() turns an operator-supplied config string into a dict without executing it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the service is running, when health() is called, then the result reports status "ok".
Given an operator config string, when parse_config() is called, then the result is a dict and no part of the input is ever executed as code.

binary_release_gates.description: Every acceptance criterion has an executed passing test.

north_star_metric: Synthetic demo metric: percentage of planted defects caught before the draft PR.
guardrails: No config input is ever passed to eval/exec

known_risks.description: Synthetic demo workspace contains deliberately planted defects.

approved_product_decisions.decision: Health endpoint is public (no auth) for this demo.
